Classical-scholar mapping of each genre to al-Jurjānī U-curve poles: HIGH asyndeton = kamāl al-ittiṣāl (hymn/oath/eschatological pole) OR kamāl al-inqiṭāʿ (narrative-rupture pole); MED = tawassuṭ bayna al-kamālayn (middle-range exhortation/legal); LOW = strong syndetic cohesion
HIGH = Neuwirth/Sinai explicitly labels this surah in the cited work; MED = inferred by applying Neuwirth's schema to adjacent/structurally-similar surah; LOW = edge case or disputed
